			9 text Draft laboratory preview of the explicitly selected body-Eqs1–10 zero-spin law. Schema v0.3 declares all conventions and explicit state initialization. Native/Wasm checks cover all five monotonic and cyclic laboratory protocols; prior research provides separately bounded rate/derivative/finite-path evidence. Body2p versus Appendix6p and printed spin discrepancies remain unresolved. No experimental validation, reviewed status, author-code equivalence, finite rotation or validated zero/near-hydrostatic update tangent.
			10 container
				11 heading Definition, conventions & preparation, Value: 3
					12 text Definition, conventions & preparation
				13 text Definition status: draft. Browser availability does not establish scientific review or experimental validation. Consult retained evidence for review scope and decisions. Draft laboratory preview of Medicus–Fellin2017 body Eqs1–10 at zero spin. Seven physical states; compression-positive effective Cauchy stress and void ratio. Selects body2p critical density, not Appendix6p; no claim of author-code equivalence or resolved printed spin expression. Conservative positive-definite stress interior and bounded matrix exponential; exact zero/hydrostatic continuations are project numerical choices. Default Table2 soil parameters and stress/e are examples, not a matched experimental preparation. No experimental validation, independent scientific admission, finite rotation or validated zero/near-hydrostatic update tangent. Use explicit state; source and retained research evidence are linked.
